about: What the frozen code sprite sprites/ui-name-plate.js drew and answered in every call the tests that read it made, recorded so the code can go (docs/data-sprites.md section 5, R2b/R3). From the frozen copy tests/fixtures/code-sprites/ui-name-plate.js (a word-for-word copy of the library's sprites/ui-name-plate.js as it was before its redraw; the working tree of 2026-11-21 on top of commit abbc3db). Frames: palette indices, little-endian 16-bit, deflated, base64 (palette[0] is "no pixel"); calls: answers of fps(), sockets(), slice() and textArea(), JSON text or null. Keys: first 16 hex digits of the SHA-1 of the call's sorted-key JSON (tests/helpers/code-replay.mjs callKey). Read by tests/helpers/code-replay.mjs replaySprite(id). Recorded by: m9-ui-redraws.

def.name: Name plate
def.blurb: A small stretchable plate for a name over a character, with a level badge, a lit state for the one targeted and a notch pointing down; change its style, corners, band, shadow and colours.

pointer.label: Notch, set under the plate's middle
